highlights.title: Elon Musk's xAI faces threat of NAACP lawsuit over air pollution from Mississippi data center
highlights.description: Law firms representing the NAACP sent xAI a notice of intent to sue over alleged Clean Air Act violations in Mississippi.

highlights.title: Three New Apple Home Products Rumored for 2026
highlights.description: Apple has a long list of new products rumored for 2026, including a series of home products that will see the company establishing more of a presence in the smart home space. Robots are on the horizon for 2027, but the 2026 releases will be a little tamer. HomePod mini We're expecting a new HomePod mini 2 to launch at any time. Apple isn't going to update the device's design, but we could get new colors. The ‌HomePod mini‌ 2 will have an updated S-series chip based on the Apple Watch Series 10 c

highlights.title: What’s new in Android’s February 2026 Google System Updates [U]
highlights.description: The monthly “Google System Release Notes” primarily detail what’s new in Play services, Play Store, and Play system update across Android phones/tablets, Wear OS, Google/Android TV, Auto, and PC. Some features apply to end users, while others are aimed at developers. more…

highlights.title: Amazon-backed X-Energy gets green light for mini reactor fuel production
Apple Music pokes fun at latest Spotify price increase
highlights.description: Last month, Spotify announced a new round of price increases for subscribers in the United States and other countries. As the price increases start to go into effect starting with February renewals, Apple Music is poking fun at Spotify’s drama on social media. Apple Music is also offering a free three-month trial right now. more…

highlights.title: Airbnb plans to bake in AI features for search, discovery and support
highlights.description: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said the company wants to increase its use of large language models for customer discovery, support and engineering.

highlights.title: Indian pharmacy chain giant exposed customer data and internal systems
highlights.description: A backend flaw in web admin dashboards used by one of India's largest pharmacy chains, exposed thousands of online pharmacy orders.
